title: bus-completion
intention: THE BUS BECOMES THE THING IT WAS DESIGNED TO BE. Today the substrate is built and PROVEN — one door (`post`), addresses (`to`), four channels, owner-gated transit through db_domain, every envelope carrying its why + causality — but the half that makes it USABLE was never built: (1) there are NO VERBS (the envelope has an opaque `body`; no dispatch); (2) there is NO MENU (a device publishes no list of what it accepts, so a caller must read source); (3) there is NO DELIVERY — `post()` writes a row and STOPS; nothing routes it to the addressee, `shim.deliver()` has zero callers outside proofs, and no device anywhere defines `receive`; (4) SYNC does not exist — `reply_to` is an orphan field with no correlation, no wait, no timeout. This node builds all four, plus the EXTERNAL-DEVICE adapter (CC and Akien are participants with addresses and feeds, not operators through a side door), and closes the silent-drop hole in `deliver` (a device with no handler currently returns None — a Law 7 breach sitting in the delivery path). The aim, in Akien's words: know an ADDRESS and a VERB, read the device's announce menu to learn the verbs, and that is the whole interface — the heavy lifting in the base shim, customized only where the participant is external.
why: The bus is the SECOND SUBSTRATE and the sole path for inter-device communication — but a substrate nothing rides is a hypothesis, not a floor (Law 3). MEASURED 2026-07-25: `cairn/tools/base/shim.py:122` is the ONLY producer in the whole tree and there are ZERO consumers; every existing device (ground_loop, harbor_master, web_server, system_rackmount, the domains) talks AROUND the bus because there is nothing to talk over. Every day that holds, devices grow private paths and the single-door property erodes by default rather than by decision (the exact UU disease the bus charter names: logic split between the bus and the web server). This PRECEDES THE LIBRARIAN by Akien's call (2026-07-25): the librarian is a CHAT SURFACE, and chat over a bus with no delivery would post into a table nobody reads and then quietly compensate with its own path — building it first would bake the hole in and the 'proven' whole would stop being proven (solidify-the-layer-below). Law 1 is the sharpest why for HOW: the design is ALREADY SETTLED in I-heartbeat-probes-and-bus.md (advertise -> subscribe -> poke; 'a device advertises a menu of what it offers'; 'advertise/subscribe/poke are all just bus messages'; 'the human is a native participant'). This node BUILDS that settled design — re-deriving it would itself be the defect.
traces_to: I-heartbeat-probes-and-bus.md (the converged two-substrate architecture — the advertise/subscribe/poke registration protocol and the device menu are SETTLED there, 2026-07-18; this node implements, it does not re-design — Law 1)
the bus charter (cairn/devices/bus/intention+why.json — the substrate half, built + proven 2026-07-18; this is its unbuilt half, and it harvests filed_edge (d), the human as a native participant)
Law 4 (single-door comms makes inspectable + logged + common PHYSICS, not per-surface policy — but only once traffic actually flows through the door)
Law 6 (a device resolves its own method internally and owns its inbound handling; a caller never reaches object.object.method — address + verb is the whole interface)
Law 7 (a delivery that silently drops on a missing handler is the breach found today; arrival, refusal, and timeout are all LOUD)
Law 3 (a substrate with one producer and zero consumers is an unmeasured claim — this node is what makes the bus MEASURED in anger)
Law 1 (the announce menu is COMPILED from what a device declares, never hand-listed — the same defect the installer exists to kill)
founding intention (get Akien out of running the system — the human participates on the bus like any device rather than operating through a side door)
shrinking-footprint / event-not-poll (delivery is a POKE fired by the post; a scan, a daemon, or a per-pulse mailbox check is the drift this node must not repeat)

supersedes-and-absorbs: the 'mail-notification /intent' held since 2026-07-23 — it was a SYMPTOM (messages never reach CC) misfiled as a feature; it dissolves into child e, the external-device adapter

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate (tester) — a proof a hollow build could not pass: post an enveloped VERB to a device's address and assert it ARRIVES at that device's declared handler and returns its result; assert an UNKNOWN verb and a DECLARED-BUT-UNHANDLED verb both go RED rather than silently returning None (the hole measured today); assert the announce MENU matches the device's declared handlers with no hand-written list anywhere (add a handler, it appears in the menu with no other edit); assert a SYNC call returns the correlated reply and that a reply that never comes FAILS LOUD on timeout rather than hanging or returning empty; assert ASYNC still returns immediately without a reply; assert delivery is fired BY the post (no scan, no daemon, no per-pulse mailbox check — a proof that stops the clock and still delivers); assert an EXTERNAL participant with no poke path retrieves the same envelopes by reading its own feed. VALIDATION persisted beside-code via cairn/devices/tester/validation_store.persist_validation. Invariant per code-seam: proved + feeds back to origin on failure (Laws 3 + 8). Durability gate: not done until proven AND committed.
falsifier.proves_red: Devices talk to each other knowing only an ADDRESS and a VERB, learn the verbs from the target's announce menu, get a loud answer or a loud failure every time, and no device holds a reference to another. Wrong-intent signals, each RED: (1) a posted envelope with a valid to + verb does NOT reach the addressee's handler (delivery still a no-op — today's actual state); (2) a missing/unknown handler returns silently instead of RED (Law 7 — the measured hole); (3) the menu is HAND-LISTED rather than compiled from declared handlers (Law 1 — a second record of truth that drifts from the code); (4) SYNC is built as a SECOND door rather than async-plus-a-correlated-wait (the single-door property lost at the moment it gets its first real use); (5) a sync call HANGS or returns empty instead of failing loud on timeout (CP1); (6) delivery becomes a POLL — a scan, a daemon, or a per-pulse mailbox check — rather than a poke fired by the post (the nightly-cron drift, repeated); (7) a caller reaches into a device's internals (object.object.method) instead of address + verb, or a device holds a reference to another device; (8) the bus opens its own store instead of riding db_domain, or a non-`bus` writer writes transit (Law 6, inherited from the substrate); (9) A DEVICE ENDS UP WITH TWO MENUS or two registries of what it offers — `declared_verbs()` and `probes()` both public, or verbs and pokes carried as different kinds on the wire (Akien's collapse, 2026-07-25: a menu of verbs and a menu of pokes ARE THE SAME THING — one menu, one exchange, or the build has re-derived the split it was cast to prevent); (10) THE BUILD ADDS NET NEW VOCABULARY — every name this node introduces must retire at least one, because the system already has more names than can be held in a head (Akien, 2026-07-25).
falsifier.horizon: first real cross-process split. Re-check THEN: (a) does the in-process POKE become Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY behind the SAME door — a transport swap with no API change — or did the door leak an in-process assumption? (b) does verbs + delivery finally create the multi-owner need that the bus charter's filed_edge (b) (per-device-OWNED inbound channels) waits on? (c) does the MCP wire adapter at the edge (filed_edge (a)) become the external-participant transport, retiring the hook in child e? (d) do VERB and CALLBACK-MENU-ITEM stay one vocabulary or two (see the recorded distinction)? None of these gate the build; all are best-guesses-with-an-expiry.

how: Complete the bus substrate: (a) verb field on probes, (b) announced_verbs() menu, (c) delivery poke from post() to shim.deliver(), (d) parameterized exchange, (e) external-device adapter, (f) first real rider closing the existing half-loop. Children are ordered by dependency.
